reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Helm option `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` has been deprecated (now a no-op) and will be removed in Cilium 1.18", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The Helm option hubble.relay.dialTimeout is now a no-op and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; it has no functional effect in 1.17.0 but remains configurable without causing failure.

proposed.statement: The Helm value `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` has been deprecated in Cilium 1.17.0 (now a no-op) and will be removed in Cilium 1.18.
